title: Corpus Christi Saltwater Fishing Charters
specs: Captain has over 30 years fishing experience in Corpus Christi area
Fish species include redfish, trout, flounder, sheepshead, drum
Fishing locations include Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, Corpus Christi Bay, Oso Bay, Shamrock Cove, The Land Cut
If 17 years or older, individual Texas saltwater fishing license required
Footwear with good tread for traction
Multi-boat trips for groups of six or more, coordinated by Captain Rock

blurb: Guests fish inshore bays around Corpus Christi including Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, Corpus Christi Bay, Oso Bay, Shamrock Cove, and The Land Cut. Fishing methods include live bait, artificial lures, and drift fishing from the boat. Wade fishing trips are available upon request.
extraNote: No fish, no pay guarantee · Usually launches out of Clems Marina, approximately 15 minutes from Port Aransas or 20 minutes from Portland.
